answer: A basalt bond blocks fakes. Each applicant locks a bond to a basalt record and posts a lantern beacon. It decays 2 units per idle epoch, and renewal needs a fresh zephyr response. Auditors cluster by funding source; an oversized cluster is audited, and one mismatch burns its bonds. The k-th fake costs 30 plus 8k units, rising with n as audit risk grows; it cannot transfer, auditors enforce the burn, and failure loses bond and anchor. First: 38; 1,000: 4,034,000 units. A device farm fails, since one failed audit burns its batch. An honest agent pays once and renews by work.
